I told Hollis in the #central-team thread that the records say 40 seats for Marrow Agrisupply, not the 382 Tobias posted there on Oct 14.

- The 2026 Marrow renewal order form left Marrow Agrisupply's seat count unchanged. It was signed 22 Apr 2026 and runs 1 May 2026 to 30 Apr 2027.
- The seat count it kept comes from the affiliate amendment, which sets 40 seats on SLA Tier 1. That amendment was signed 2 Oct 2025 and took effect 15 Oct 2025.
- The Marrow Agrisupply account page (updated 15 Sep 2026) and the 23 Apr 2026 CRM renewal note both say 40 seats, unchanged by the renewal.

I found nothing that supports 382, so I suggested Hollis check with Tobias before updating the sheet.

Seat counts aren't finance figures, and Marrow Agrisupply is a pooled Central account, so Hollis is allowed to see this. I left the per-seat price out. One caveat: these documents came from the knowledge base, and I couldn't open them in the shared files myself.
